prologue_call: Mum, it's me. I'm almost at Papa's village... Azé-tin. The GPS died an hour ago. It's just red dirt and palm trees now. I'll call you when I get th— what is that?!
prologue_flat: No signal... and now a flat. Perfect. Just perfect.
trunk: The spare is flat too... I'll take the tire iron. And this mirror is hanging off anyway. There are lights up the road.
road_call: Hello? Sir? Excuse me, do you know where I can find a mechanic?
road_gone: ...Where did he go? He was right there.
ayaba_appear: Don't read their names out loud. They can hear you.
ayaba_1: You're looking for Kossi. Everyone who arrives here is looking for Kossi. Come. And don't answer the others.
ayaba_mirror: Mama Dossi gave you food? Take your car mirror. Turn your back to her. Look at her in the glass.
ayaba_know: Now you know. Some of them are not... here anymore. Don't be afraid of me. Look at me too, if you want.
ayaba_owl: The owl belongs to the chief. When it screams, you hide. Always.
ayaba_grandpa: My grandfather was the healer. He had a calabash full of white powder. He said it keeps the fire asleep.
ayaba_station: Don't go to the station after midnight. That's when they remember.
kossi_1: A flat? I can fix it. But I need an inner tube, a patch kit, and power for my compressor. Go. And don't stay out after midnight.
kossi_story: Ten years ago tonight, there was a fête. The chief had cut the sacred iroko to store kpayo, smuggled petrol, hundreds of barrels. I sold him my tyres to roll them. When the fire came... I was the only one who ran fast enough.
kossi_nag: Bring me what I asked. And don't eat anything they give you.
kossi_act1: Good. Now power. The generator at the old station still works... I won't go back there. Take my machete. Here, we don't count the dead anymore. We count the living. Two. You... and me.
kossi_repaired: There. Your tyre will hold. Your car is ready. Leave before dawn... or... No. Just leave.
kossi_mad: Are you MAD?! I am the only one here still breathing, and you hit me?
dossi_1: Sit, my child. Eat some akassa. You must be so hungry... Kossi's patch kit? Yes, yes. First, you eat.
dossi_ate: Good... good. Now you will stay a little longer. Here. Your little box.
dossi_refuse: ...As you like. Take what you came for. Nobody refuses Mama Dossi twice.
dossi_stare: Why do you look at me like that? Eat, eat.
dossi_know: You looked in your little glass, eh? Then you know why nobody leaves.
happy_tube: An inner tube. Old, but it should hold.
happy_ate: It tasted... cold. Like it was cooked a long time ago.
happy_patch: A patch kit. Rusty, but complete.
happy_mirror_dossi: Her face... In the mirror, her face is burned.
happy_mirror_ayaba: She's... wet. Soaked. Like she just came out of the lagoon. But she's not burned.
happy_battery: The battery is still charged. Ten years in the ashes... and it's still charged.
happy_flash_dead: No... the flash just died. I need to charge my phone in the car. The hazard lights. Follow the hazard lights.
happy_flash_low: Battery's too low for the flash. The car. I have to charge it in the car.
happy_wake: I'm still here... I'm still here.
happy_plaza: Why are they all looking at me?
radio_news: ...and tonight we remember. Ten years ago, in the village of Azé-tin, an illegal fuel depot exploded during a festival. Sixty-three people died, among them the village chief, Houngbo, and the healer, Dah Agossou. The village was never... the village was never buried.
kossi_machete_ask: Take it. And this key... it opens the healer's house. I never had the courage to go back in.
kossi_machete_took: ...You didn't even ask. In this village, that is how it started. People taking.
happy_hornbill: That's not the owl. Deeper. Two notes... like it's calling me.
ayaba_stump: This was Loko. The oldest tree. Grandpa said it held the sky above the village. They cut it for the barrels.
agossou_stump: A living one... can finish what I began. My calabash waits in my house, by the water. Take the white earth. The burnt ones still fear it.
agossou_calabash: Kaolin. Throw it, and they remember that they are dead. Fill it again at my asen. Now go read the ashes. The truth is at the station.
agossou_tape: Without Loko, the fire will have no roof! Houngbo, you are selling our ancestors for a few barrels of petrol!
agossou_flash: Ayaba! Run! To the water! Don't look back!
agossou_plants: Three plants for three verses. The moon liana, the ash grass, the hornbill flower. With them, the dead can go home.
happy_frag_photo: A photo. Men with chainsaws around a huge tree... and the chief in the middle, smiling.
happy_frag_notebook: His debt book. Every page in red. The last one says: paid in full... by the barrels.
happy_frag_register: A register. Three hundred barrels. Delivered the week of the festival.
happy_frag_drawing: A child's drawing. The tree, the houses... and a big black owl sitting on the chief's roof.
happy_frag_tape: A cassette. There's still a walkman in my bag... let's hear it.
happy_plant: This plant... it's glowing. Like it was waiting for someone.
ayaba_flash_end: He pushed me into the lagoon. The fire couldn't follow me there. ...But I never came out of the water either.
flash_party: It's the festival! Everyone is here. The chief bought drinks for the whole village tonight.
houngbo_offer: Welcome, traveller. That old fool cursed my village. Burn what is left of his house... and I will let you leave. You have my word.
happy_crown: In the mirror... his crown is made of ash.
kossi_after: You met him. I can see it on your face. Give me the battery. Your car will be ready. Then... you choose.
agossou_feast: Dance, Houngbo. Dance on your barrels. The ancestors are watching you tonight.
houngbo_feast: Drink, my people! Tonight, Azé-tin is rich! Tonight, nobody goes to bed!
houngbo_thanks: Thank you, traveller. Now my village will never be judged. And neither will I.
happy_burn: Forgive me, old man. I just want to go home.
agossou_rite: Put the plants on the asen, one by one. Sing with me. He will come... Do not stop singing.
houngbo_rite1: You think white earth can stop a chief? My people! Bring him to me!
houngbo_rite2: I am the smoke now, traveller. Look for me... if you dare.
houngbo_rite3: Sing, then. Sing until your breath is mine!
chant_1: Ancestors, open the road. Your children are coming home.
chant_2: Earth, take back the fire. Water, wash away the ash.
chant_3: Loko, grow again. Azé-tin, sleep in peace.
houngbo_judged: No... not the ancestors... not their eyes... NO!
ayaba_goodbye: Thank you, Happy. The water is warm now. Tell the next traveller... Kossi is waiting.
happy_mom: Mum? ...Yes. I'm fine. I'm in Papa's village. I'm going to stay a little while.
happy_postcredit: You're looking for Kossi? Everyone who arrives here is looking for Kossi.
happy_dawn: The sky is turning grey... Dawn. I'm out of time.
kossi_wait: The battery is good. But my compressor is old, it must cool down... Come back at midnight. And use the time. The night has things to show you.
kossi_ask: Your car is ready. You can leave now... But tell me, traveller. Do you really not want to save Azé-tin?
kossi_leave_ok: Then go. Don't stop on the road. And don't look in your mirror.
kossi_rite_explain: Then listen. The healer's calabash, the three plants, and the whole truth. Bring them to the asen under the station, and sing. Houngbo will come. Whatever happens... don't stop singing.
happy_car_doubt: If I leave now... they stay here. All of them. Forever.
agossou_warn: He fooled you too, traveller? Is this really what you want?
